# Knowledge index

<!-- generated by `knowledge.mjs index` — do not edit -->

## stack (6)

- [[bff-only-data-access]] — All data goes through server routes using the service-role key; the browser uses Supabase for auth only, and anon/authenticated get no grants. _(decision)_
- [[idempotent-migrations]] — Every SQL migration must be safely re-runnable — IF [NOT] EXISTS, guarded DO blocks, scoped backfills, ON CONFLICT seeds, drop old function signatures first. _(rule)_
- [[never-edit-committed-migrations]] — Once a migration file is committed it is frozen, even if not yet applied — fix forward with a new migration that redefines the object. _(rule)_
- [[nuxt-content-site]] — The "site" scaffold is one Nuxt app where every Markdown file in content/ is a page; colours live in app/assets/css/main.css; `npm run generate` builds static HTML. _(howto)_
- [[server-owned-user-data]] — A user's role and scope come only from a server-owned table; server-owned user fields go in app_metadata; never read user_metadata (users can edit it). _(rule)_
- [[shared-zod-schemas]] — Each module has row/create/update Zod schemas in packages/shared, used by the form, the server route (readValidatedBody) and tests — never duplicated. _(rule)_

## meta (5)

- [[agent-kit-architecture]] — Behaviour (skills, hooks, agent) ships as a versioned Claude Code plugin from the agent-kit marketplace; the npx CLI only asks fixed questions and writes project files; knowledge and scripts are plain files in git, handled by zero-dependency Node scripts. _(decision)_
- [[knowledge-scopes]] — Project scopes (business, env, decisions, ux, stack, local) live in .knowledge/; global scopes (stack, meta, ux) live in the agent-kit repo; only one-line summaries load per session. _(concept)_
- [[promote-reused-scripts]] — Throwaway scripts go in .agent-kit/scratch/ (gitignored, searchable); the second time one is needed it moves to scripts/<area>/ with a header (@summary, @usage), a ZOMBIES test and an index line; cross-project ones go to the agent-kit library. _(rule)_
- [[work-lanes]] — Every request is Answer (read-only), Fast-track (≤3 files, no schema/permission/money change) or Spec (spec → approval → tasks → verified ACs); the project method is SDD or SDD + TDD (tests first, enforced by preflight). _(concept)_
- [[zombies-testing]] — Pick test cases with ZOMBIES — Zero, One, Many, Boundaries, Interface, Exceptions, Simple — keeping only the categories that apply and starting with the simplest. _(howto)_

## ux (7)

- [[confirm-every-action]] — No one-click mutations — every button that writes opens a confirmation or form dialog that says concretely what will change and whether it can be undone. _(rule)_
- [[help-in-popovers]] — Explanations of a field go in a question-icon popover next to its label, never as paragraphs inside the form. _(rule)_
- [[no-mixed-scale-sort]] — A column is sortable only if every row is on the same scale and unit — multi-currency amounts sort by a common equivalent or not at all. _(rule)_
- [[no-people-names-in-ui]] — Labels, help text and toasts describe roles or actions, never a specific operator's name — people change, the UI shouldn't. _(rule)_
- [[select-loading-empty-states]] — A select whose options come from data shows one disabled "Loading..." item while loading and one disabled "No data" item when empty — it never opens blank. _(rule)_
- [[server-side-lists]] — Pagination, filters and sorting run in the list RPC and are mirrored to the URL query; never filter a fully loaded array on the client. _(rule)_
- [[static-dialog-headers]] — DialogTitle/DialogDescription render static text; values that echo user input go in the form body next to their field. _(rule)_
